lines.en: How long had the police taken to find his bicycle?
lines.cn: 警察花了多长时间才找到他的自行车？

lines.en: Dan Robinson has been worried all week.
lines.cn: 丹·罗宾逊整个星期都一直很担心。

lines.en: Last Tuesday he received a letter
lines.cn: 上周二，他收到了一封信。

lines.en: from the local police.
In the letter he was asked to call at the station.
lines.cn: 在信中，他被要求去车站一趟。

lines.en: Dan wondered why
he was wanted by the police,
but he went to the station yesterday
and now he is not worried anymore.
At the station,
he was told by a smiling policeman
lines.cn: 一位面带微笑的警察告诉了他这件事。

lines.en: that his bicycle had been found.
lines.cn: 他的自行车已经被找到了。

lines.en: Five days ago, the policeman told him,
the bicycle was picked up in a small village
lines.cn: 这辆自行车是在一个小镇上被捡到的。

lines.en: four hundred miles away.
It is now being sent to his home by train.
lines.cn: 它现在正通过火车被送往他的家中。

lines.en: Dan was most surprised
when he heard the news.
He was amused too,
because he never expected
lines.cn: 因为他从未预料到会发生这样的事。

lines.en: the bicycle to be found.
It was stolen twenty years ago
lines.cn: 它是在二十年前被偷走的。

lines.en: when Dan was a boy of fifteen!
